blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The year-end balances of Atty. Manases “Mans” Carpio’s Land Bank of the Philippines (LBP) account at its Davao R. Magsaysay branch from 2022 to 2025 were unveiled Tuesday during the impeachment trial of his wife, Vice President Sara Duterte. Prosecution counsel Atty. James Alih presented LBP R. Magsaysay Branch Manager Raquel dela Cerna, who testified that Carpio has an active bank account with the branch ending in 2730. “In my records, year-end December 2022 is P505,517.35 … for year-end 2023, the outstanding balance at that time was P953,681.42 … for 2024 it was P115,824.20 … for 2025 it […]... Keep on reading: Mans Carpio’s Landbank account balances from 2022-2025 unveiled at trial
